Dear Mark,

Thank you for the time you gave us on our October 5 call. This proposal accompanies the enclosed engagement letter and describes how Onyx Accounting Group would support Arizona Center for Hand to Shoulder Surgery as you move toward retirement.

We have organized it around what we heard. The first priority is continuity: a consistent senior finance contact for the physicians, knowledge transfer from you before you retire, and a monthly close that stays on track across all three entities. Behind that sits the work that needs controller and CFO judgment: physician compensation and the mid-month bonus, revenue-cycle and borrowing-base reporting, less manual work between eClinicalWorks, payroll and QuickBooks Online, and an automation roadmap with review controls.

Our fees are hourly at the rates in Section 05. You pay for the hours worked, and you can start with CFO plus controller, controller-led or staff support and change the mix by email. There is no minimum term.
We would welcome the opportunity to work with your team and are glad to walk through any part of this proposal before October 16.

Onyx Accounting Group is a Scottsdale, Arizona accounting firm that provides bookkeeping, controller and CFO services to privately held companies. We are an Elite Level Partner of Intuit (QuickBooks Online) and work inside our clients' own systems as an extension of their finance team, covering the full range from transaction detail to the owner's table.
Big-firm background
Our leadership held Director and Manager roles at top 10 national accounting firms and brings that standard of review and documentation to privately held companies.
Industry experience
Construction and the trades, real estate and property management, professional services, distribution and retail, and hospitality.
Ownership structures
Owner-led, private equity backed and family office companies, including lender, investor and audit reporting.
Scottsdale team
Engagement leadership, the controller and CFO roles, every judgment call, and on-site time in Phoenix for onboarding and training.
Supporting staff
Reconciliations, schedules and transaction support prepared on our systems by accountants with ten or more years of experience.
Perform and review
The person who prepares a number is never the person who approves it. Every reconciliation, journal entry and report is reviewed by a second accountant before it reaches you.
One file, not one person
Procedures, the close checklist and the open-items list live in a shared file your team can see, so nothing depends on a single individual.

The principal leads the engagement and stays on it as your relationship lead. Lisa Danforth, CPA, provides CFO-level support, and Jessica Bumphus leads the controller work. Staff support is assigned as the work settles, and the mix is adjusted with you.

Our understanding of the practice
**The practice.** Physician-owned hand and trauma practice since 2000: 15 surgeons, five clinics with therapy suites, 24/7 trauma call at 17 hospitals. Revenue over $32 million.
**Finance team.** Mark Williamson, CFO, retiring. A supervisory accountant, three staff and an international AP resource.
**Systems.** QuickBooks Online with physician classes, eClinicalWorks for EMR and billing, Paylocity payroll (Paychex under evaluation).
**Banking and structure.** Lines of credit with borrowing-base reporting. Entities: the practice, a surgery center acquired in 2024 and Arizona Pharmacy Consultants.
Dependable finance leadership now, without waiting for another hire to ramp up.
Controller-led close and operational finance, with knowledge transfer from Mark before he retires.
A consistent senior contact the physicians can trust and reach.
Less manual work between eClinicalWorks, payroll and QuickBooks Online, with review controls on any automation.
A path that can grow into broader CFO leadership: budgeting, board and lender reporting.

Compared with a single full-time hire
Continuity
You work with a team, not one individual. If a person changes, the file, the procedures and your senior contact do not.
Depth
CFO, controller and staff expertise under one engagement, with a built-in review process so the work is completed accurately and consistently.
Flexibility
Start with CFO plus controller, controller-led or staff augmentation, and move between them by email. No penalties and no paperwork to redo.
Fit
We work alongside your team, CBIZ and your bank, and we keep approvals with you. A stable close, multi-entity reporting and lender reporting in QuickBooks Online are what we do every day.
Review
Share this proposal and the engagement letter with the physicians ahead of October 16. We are glad to join the meeting or a follow-up call.
Sign
Sign the letter; we can send it for electronic signature. The retainer, set after we review the books, starts the work.
Grant access
QuickBooks Online for each entity, eClinicalWorks reporting, Paylocity, bank and loan view access, and the discovery materials.
Kick off
On site in Phoenix the following week. Knowledge transfer from Mark, close review and the first weekly update begin in week one.
